scope: Finite known states and exact labels; deterministic stationary dynamics; trusted resettable successor oracle
queries: Each map's start state, independently for AG !danger, EF goal, and E[!danger U goal]
training: Reuse the three existing 40-map, 100-epoch checkpoints; no training or architecture changes
initial_upper_relation: All states are possible successors of each state/action; no test-fitted radius
refinement: Validate a candidate path from its start; each new exact successor query replaces only that action's upper set by the observed singleton; recheck on the first mismatch
cache: Fresh per map/start/property/method; count every distinct queried state/action once

priority.cegar_jepa: Unknown edge cost is 1 plus the zero-based same-row target-distance rank; confirmed edges cost 1
priority.cegar_shuffled: Independently permute each target rank row with a fixed seed derived from model seed and case index; confirmed edges cost 1
priority.direct_bfs: Exact on-demand breadth-first exploration with fixed action order, stopping on a witness or exhausted reachable region

exploratory_support_rule.interpretation: Engineering screen for JEPA's incremental query-saving value, not statistical significance, scalability evidence, or a generalization certificate

prohibited_shortcuts: Calling true dynamics during neural priority construction
Using test errors to initialize a radius
Deleting an edge because the network assigns low plausibility
Totalizing the observed lower graph with invented self-loops
Reporting unknown as true or false
Tuning priorities after observing these results
